=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:283-286,360 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `pr_scope` exclusion tests only `event` in {pull_request, pull_request_target} or a foreign `head_repository`, so a same-repo `push` or `workflow_dispatch` run on a PR branch is still seeded and its scripts are read at the PR head SHA.
  WHY: A PR author can widen the frozen heal scope, which the rule was meant to prevent; the plan does not record this as an accepted residual risk. Reviewers rated it MAJOR; "high" is the mapped value.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:283-286 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `pr_scope` check is described only for verified parent runs, and seeds from `linked_scope.json` runs (which carry no `event` or `head_repository`) get no PR-scope check.
  WHY: A same-repo `workflow_dispatch` child of a skipped PR parent is still seeded and read at the PR head SHA, reopening the scope-widening hole.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:110,235,251 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `HEAL_SCOPE_RENDER_VERSION` is bumped by one in each of P1 and P2, but the plan does not say which phase creates the constant or give per-phase absolute values.
  WHY: Phases are mergeable in any order, so parallel PRs can both land at 2 instead of 3, and a `needs_human` marker at render=2 is never re-evaluated.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:291,296,298,306 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rescope candidate exclusion matches any `ai:heal-rescope:v1` marker with the same `denied=` and `render=` regardless of `outcome`, and the existing cap filter (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:188-191`) does not count `ai:heal-rescope:v1 outcome=failed` markers.
  WHY: One transient failure permanently excludes the heal, so `HEAL_SCOPE_RECOVERY_SCAN_MAX_ATTEMPTS` is never reached and no retry occurs.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:187,194-196,291,298 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The second rescope candidate list is not stated to feed the `--list-only` `COUNT`, which is computed only from the markerless recovery `CANDIDATES_FILE`.
  WHY: Held heals carry the scope marker and are dropped from that file, so COUNT stays 0, the `recovery-scan` job is skipped, and rescope never runs.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:177,293-295 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rescope candidate rule accepts `source=poller`, but `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope` is emitted only by the plan gate, so a later poller hold with another reason can displace the live plan hold as the newest hold. (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 examined this claim and did not report it.)
  WHY: The `source=poller` case is unreachable and the displacement silently drops the heal from rescope candidates. Reviewer confidence was 3 (gemini, minimax) and 4 (glm).
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:294-295 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `(created_at, id)` hold-vs-plan comparison needs comment `createdAt` and `databaseId`, but `LIST_QUERY` (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:162`) fetches only `body` and `author`, and a plan comment outside the last-30 window is not covered.
  WHY: The comparison has no data to run on, so stale holds may pass as newer than the plan.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:307,400 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Rollout calls `HEAL_SCOPE_RESCOPE_ENABLED` the single off control and says recovery is unaffected, but rescope runs inside the job and script gated by `HEAL_SCOPE_RECOVERY_ENABLED`.
  WHY: Setting `HEAL_SCOPE_RECOVERY_ENABLED=false` also disables rescope, so the declared and effective switch semantics differ. Severity disagreement: NIT from anthropic, gemini, minimax and glm; MAJOR from openai_gpt-6-luna. The highest is used.
